transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I really hope I'm not wasting your time with this, um... well, it's probably just a little quirk, but my family and some of my colleagues at the high school where I teach encouraged me to come in. 

It's just that I seem to have a habit of... well, I keep getting up during staff meetings or at dinner when everyone else is seated. It's not that I'm trying to be disruptive! I just, um, I'll suddenly feel the need to go refill my coffee, or maybe check a handout, or I'll just walk to the back of the room for a moment. Even though nothing is really urgent at all. I just like to stay active and be helpful, I suppose? But it seems to be distracting people, and I feel a bit embarrassed about it. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that okay.
When you stay seated, do you get a strong anxious feeling that something bad will happen unless you get up?

Oh, no, no, nothing like that at all. It's not... I don't feel any sort of dread or fear that something terrible will happen. I hope that's okay? 

It's really just more of a... well, my legs just feel like they need to stretch, or I just feel a little burst of energy and I'd rather be on my feet. I definitely don't feel panicked or anxious about it. I'm so sorry if I made it sound like an anxiety thing! I just get a little physically restless, I suppose. Is that normal? I hope I'm answering your question right.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized or high for several days in a row?

Oh, goodness, no. I hope I didn't make it sound like I'm... well, out of control or anything! No, I've never felt high or unusually energized for days on end. 

I just have my normal, everyday energy. It's just that sometimes my normal energy likes to... well, express itself by me needing to walk around a little bit. But I definitely don't have stretches of days where I feel overly energized or anything extreme like that. I'm just a regular, slightly fidgety teacher, I suppose. I really hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.
Do you ever have brief, sudden movements that happen over and over, like shoulder shrugging, blinking, or head jerking, that feel hard to hold back?

Oh, um, no. No, I don't think I do anything like that. I mean, maybe I'll adjust my glasses or, you know, shift my weight, but I don't have any sudden jerks or twitches or anything like that. 

I'm pretty sure I have control over my movements, it's just... well, sometimes I just choose to move, if that makes sense? I certainly don't have any repetitive tics or anything that I can't stop. I hope that's the right answer? I just want to be as helpful as possible, and I don't want you to think I'm, well, completely out of sorts!
